fbae6c52ae: Whenever you reach 0 Health, make a Body Save: Failure means you die. Success means you fall unconscious, make a Death Save to find out when you regain consciousness. Crew members with a medscanner, relevant skills like First Aid or Biology, or scientists and androids who pass an Intellect Check can determine your condition.
01e1273438: Occasionally, certain moments, places, or events can automatically calm you down. Escaping perilous situations, finding a serene location, or experiencing a touching moment with a loved one can have meaningful impacts on your mood and outlook on life. If your Calm is getting close to 0, you should consider making a Rest Save - as the effects of a failed Panic Check can be devastating.
4e28a1b9d4: You gain 1 Stress every time you fail a Stat Check or Save. Occasionally, certain locations or entities can automatically give you Stress from interacting with or witnessing them. Your Minimum Stress starts at 2, and the Maximum Stress you can have is 20. Any Stress you take over 20 instead reduces the most relevant Stat or Save by that amount.
7ff3172086: Occasionally, certain locations or entities can automatically give you Stress from interacting with or witnessing them. You live in a terrifying, uncaring universe, so your Maximum Calm caps out at 85 and cannot go lower than zero.
860bf3028a: Stress, Damage, and emotional wear and tear eventually bring characters to their breaking point. When that happens, there’s a chance they Panic. You determine this by making a Panic Check. Some results of the Panic Table are so severe that they leave a lasting impression on you. These are called Conditions, and they affect you until you are able to treat them.
dea5825cf2: Occasionally, certain moments, places, or events can automatically relieve your stress. Escaping perilous situations, finding a serene location, or experiencing a touching moment with a loved one can have meaningful impacts on your mood and outlook on life. If your stress is getting close to 20, you should consider making a Rest Save - as the effects of a failed Panic Check can be devastating.
84be47ce09: You have three Saves which represent your ability to withstand different kinds of trauma. In order to avoid certain dangers, you sometimes need to roll a Save. If you roll less than your Save you succeed. Otherwise you fail, and gain 1 Stress. A roll of 90-99 is always a failure. A Critical Failure means something bad happens, and furthermore you must make a Panic Check.
4091067385: Sanity: Rationalize logical inconsistencies in the universe, make sense out of chaos, detect illusions and mimicry, cope with Stress.
c1c84b723e: Fear: Maintain a level head while struggling with fear, loneliness, depression, and other emotional surges.
10319091d1: Body: Employ quick reflexes and resist hunger, disease, or organisms that might try and invade your insides.
c6da1f3916: Armor: Resistance to damage sustained during combat, whether that be through bullets, claws, teeth, etc.
585ee8b80e: You have four Stats which represent your ability to act under extreme pressure. Whenever you want to do something and the price for failure is high, roll a stat check. If you roll less than your Stat you succeed. Otherwise, you fail and gain 1 Stress. A roll of 90-99 is always a failure. A Critical Failure means something bad happens, and furthermore you must make a Panic Check.
9de0b8c911: Strength: Holding airlocks closed, carrying fallen comrades, climbing, pushing, jumping.
e64f7cd392: Speed: Getting out of the cargo bay before the blast doors close, acting before someone (or something) else, running away.
2af8f154dc: Intellect: Recalling your training and experience under duress, thinking through difficult problems, inventing or fixing things.
5e7bb913a5: Combat: Fighting for your life.
4f5e3a9062: Your character is incapacitated when you receive a fatal wound, or once your Current Wounds equal your Maximum Wounds. As soon as someone spends a turn checking your vitals, make a Death Save to reveal your fate. If your death seems imminent, make your last moments count: save someone’s life, solve an important mystery, or give the others time to escape.

c151c587d0: Make a Wound Roll according to the type of Damage received.

5cef749a9e: Lethal Injuries can kill you if not dealt with immediately.
56aefa8855: Bleeding wounds, if not treated can quickly overwhelm you.
